content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed it and would like to suggest one adjustment before signing: - Regarding the limitation of liability, the current terms exclude certain claims from the cap, leaving exposure uncapped. I propose we update the relevant clause so that liability is consistently limited, and suggest the following modification: In any event, the liability of the Contractor to the Client for any reason and upon any cause of action or claim in contract, tort or otherwise shall be limited to the amount paid by the Client to the Contractor in the twelve (12) month period prior to the accrual of the action or claim. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
